title: qa(checklist): records-forms — provisioning recipes for a walled two-organization mention leg, a packaged action specimen, and the app-crm import specs
body:
Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task** — in the 18.2.0 wave-2 session (2026-10-27), on the PM's list of improvements ("补测试数据配方: write the recurring fixture gaps up as area-level provisioning recipes"), the maintainer answered, verbatim: 「补测试数据配方。立卡」.
Business reason: three records-forms items left clauses unscored in wave 2 (#26450, #26456) for want of environments stock seeds do not provide.
Reader: the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` and `packages/qa/**` (`domain:devx`). The shape to copy is the area-level `fixtures` recipe block in `docs/qa/platform-checklist/README.md` ("Area-level `fixtures`"), the worked instance `qa-scratch-authz` in `areas/attachments-storage.json`; items opt in with `fixtures.provisioning.use`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "checklist fixture provisioning recipe blocked fixture knownGaps org-less approval request" → 29 hits; the nearest is #21851 (closed: four other recipes, landed). None covers the gaps below.

## Gaps

- `records-forms.record-discussion-mentions` a9, the cross-organization leg — needs a walled boot holding two organizations, the comment's record in one and the mentioned user a member of the other only (RUNNER "A walled boot is a fixture of its own"). Recipe: the walled showcase boot + the two-organization personas, and since #26497 the mention target's comment read (rev 8 persona note).
- `records-forms.action-location-matrix` A3 (fail-closed half) and A4 half (a) — knownGaps[2]: a runtime-authored action is listed under `/meta/action` but never joined into the object's `actions[]`, and a throwing `visible` is now refused at authoring (422), so the fail-closed half needs a PACKAGED specimen. Recipe: a scratch package carrying the action (declared location + a `visible` that throws at evaluation) installed through the package loader.
- `records-forms.import-job-undo-cancel` — its two specs need an app-crm boot with `IMPORT_CONSOLE_LIVE=1` (`ui/e2e/import-console/import-console-undo.spec.ts`) and the :5200 import harness over app-crm (`ui/e2e/import-harness/import-undo.spec.ts`). Recipe: the boot lines and env so a runner runs both specs instead of the hand-driven substitute.

## Done when

- The recipe is written once at the area level (a keyed block beside `items`), with the exact call sequence a runner replays on a stock showcase boot, and each listed item references it with `fixtures.provisioning.use` + `why`.
- Each listed clause is re-driven once on the recipe and its verdict recorded in the item `history` (citing this card); the item's `knownGaps` line for the gap is removed or reworded.
- `node scripts/check-platform-checklist.mjs` stays green (it resolves every `provisioning.use` and refuses an unreferenced recipe).
- A gap that turns out to be a product limit rather than a fixture (no door exists at all) is filed as its own card and stays `blocked` with that card as `blocked.ref`.
